text:
elaine: FYI support ticket #11234 — customers saying the 'API latency > 500ms' alert fired repeatedly overnight even though the latency chart looks flat (normal). Can SRE take a look?
noah: on it. Do we have the alert query / eval config?
elaine: pasted from console: `metric: api.request.latency.p95, aggregation: avg, window: 1m, threshold: >500, for: 1m`
sophie: I pulled the raw points, looks like a bunch of 0s around the same times the alerts fired. but the dashboard graph shows non-zero points once they arrive.
ingrid: :eyes: can you dump the ingestion logs for the metrics-agent around that timeframe? suspect batching/delay.
sophie: grabbing logs now — here's a snippet where the agent flushes a 3-minute batch:```
[2026-02-14T02:11:00Z] metrics-agent flush batch size=270 points duration=180s dest=ingest
[2026-02-14T02:11:00Z] metrics-agent send latency=120ms
[2026-02-14T02:12:00Z] metrics-agent flush batch size=12 points duration=60s dest=ingest
```
noah: aha — agent default flush_interval is 180s on some hosts. If the alert eval window is 1m it will see empty buckets until the batch arrives. That would explain alerts firing on zeros.
elaine: that matches the repro from the customer — alerts go off, graph looks empty for the minute, then the line jumps when batch is indexed.
ingrid: root cause summary: metrics-agent configuration mismatch (some hosts set flush_interval=180s) + alert evaluation uses short 1m windows -> transient zero-data buckets cause threshold rules to trigger.
sophie: mitigation: bump alert window to 5m + require `for: 3m` and change rollup to 1m (so chart fidelity stays). Also update agent config to flush every 60s and deploy.
noah: I've created a quick patch: repo: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4321 — changes default flush_interval to 60s and adds a per-host override check during bootstrap.
noah: patch applied to prod agent fleet in us-west-2 (rolled to 30% canary). monitoring: set temporary alert suppression for the >500ms rule while canary rolls.
monitor-bot: suppression window created (rule id: r-8934) until 2026-02-14T05:00:00Z by noah.
elaine: PR for alert tuning: github.com/redwood/console/pull/289 — sets window=5m, for=3m, evaluation_periods=3 on latency alerts.
ingrid: next steps: 1) finish fleet rollout (noah), 2) update alert templates (sophie), 3) run postmortem and add to runbook (elaine).
sophie: added tasks to runbook and a small Grafana panel that shows last ingest delta per agent to catch slow flushers.
elaine: customer notified: "We traced this to our metrics ingestion causing transient empty windows; we've adjusted alerting windows and are patching agent batching. Sorry for the noise"
noah: monitoring shows false positive alert rate down 94% after canary. will finish rollout by EOD. :thumbsup:
elaine: thanks all. marking support ticket as escalated->resolved once rollout completes. :white_check_mark:
